changes.why: new in v0.4.0: R.propOrDefault(p, val, obj) is hasOwnProperty.call(obj, p) ? obj[p] : val
new in v0.4.0: R.toPairs = pairWith(R.keys), a [key, obj[key]] pair per own key (a set here: a map has no key order)
new in v0.4.0: R.toPairsIn = pairWith(R.keysIn); a map has no prototype, so the same pairs as toPairs
v0.4.0 makes reduce the primary (var foldl = R.reduce = curry3(...), @alias foldl): the revealed body now carries the fold, with foldl's ensures, same results
v0.4.0 makes foldl the alias (R.foldl = R.reduce): the revealed body now calls reduce, same ensures and results
knock-on of foldl: its revealed body calls foldl, whose body changed; same results
knock-on of foldlIdx: its revealed body calls foldlIdx; same results
knock-on of foldl: its revealed body calls foldl; same results
knock-on of foldl: its revealed body calls foldl; same results
knock-on of chain: its revealed body calls chain; same results
